import torch

# 동일한 초기 Parameter
p_adam = torch.nn.Parameter(
    torch.tensor([1.0])
)

p_adamw = torch.nn.Parameter(
    torch.tensor([1.0])
)

# Adam: Coupled L2 Penalty
optimizer_adam = torch.optim.Adam(
    [p_adam],
    lr=0.01,
    weight_decay=0.1
)

# AdamW: Decoupled Weight Decay
optimizer_adamw = torch.optim.AdamW(
    [p_adamw],
    lr=0.01,
    weight_decay=0.1
)

# Data Loss Gradient = 0
p_adam.grad = torch.zeros_like(p_adam)
p_adamw.grad = torch.zeros_like(p_adamw)

optimizer_adam.step()
optimizer_adamw.step()

print("Adam :", p_adam.item())
print("AdamW:", p_adamw.item())

import torch
import torch.nn as nn

model = nn.Sequential(
    nn.Linear(4, 64),
    nn.ReLU(),
    nn.Linear(64, 3)
)

criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()

optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(
    model.parameters(),
    lr=1e-3,
    weight_decay=0.01
)

# 예제용 Synthetic Data
torch.manual_seed(42)

X = torch.randn(100, 4)
y = torch.randint(0, 3, (100,))

epochs = 20

for epoch in range(epochs):

    model.train()

    optimizer.zero_grad()

    logits = model(X)

    loss = criterion(logits, y)

    loss.backward()

    optimizer.step()

    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch+1:02d} "
        f"| Loss: {loss.item():.4f}"
    )
